note: Zambia: nationals of the countries and territories listed (with the overseas territories' passports) enter without a visa for 90 days a year as tourists (30 for business, not modelled); nationals of the countries listed after get a visa on arrival on the same terms; everyone else applies for an e-Visa (or the KAZA universal visa with Zimbabwe, not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Department of Immigration's own three lists (no visa; a visa on arrival, at a mission or online; a visa cleared before travel) and its notice of the waiver for 53 countries from 1 January 2025 (Statutory Instrument No. 78 of 2024): they corrected Wikipedia's copy, read before, on Ghana and on Puerto Rico and Saint Pierre and Miquelon (a visa on arrival), Panama (no visa) and Vietnam (a visa cleared before travel, applied for online). The lists give no length; the 90 days stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Zambia
sources.said: Visitors to Zambia must obtain an e-Visa unless they are citizens from one of the visa-exempt countries or citizens who may obtain a visa on arrival. ... Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter Zambia without a visa for up to 30 days within a year for business purposes or 90 days within a year for tourist purposes: All European Union member states Albania Andorra Angola Antigua and Barbuda Argentina Australia Bahamas Bahrain Barbados Belize Bhutan Bosnia and Herzegovina Botswana Brunei Canada Cape Verde China Comoros Costa Rica Dominica Dominican Republic Eswatini Fiji Ghana Grenada Guatemala Guyana Honduras Hong Kong Iceland Iraq Israel Jamaica Japan Kenya Kiribati Kuwait Laos Lesotho Liberia Liechtenstein Madagascar Malawi Malaysia Maldives Marshall Islands Mauritius Micronesia Moldova Monaco Montenegro Morocco Mozambique Namibia Nauru New Zealand North Macedonia Norway Oman Palau Papua New Guinea Qatar Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Samoa San Marino Sao Tome and Principe Saudi Arabia Serbia Seychelles Singapore Solomon Islands South Africa South Korea Suriname Switzerland Tanzania Tonga Trinidad and Tobago Turkey Tuvalu Uganda Ukraine United Arab Emirates United Kingdom United States Vanuatu Vatican City Zimbabwe In addition, visa exemption applies to holders of passports issued to residents of the following territories ... Citizens of the following countries and territories may obtain a visa for Zambia on arrival for up to 30 days for business purposes or 90 days for tourist purposes: Belarus Bolivia Brazil Burundi Chile Colombia Congo DR Congo Cuba Djibouti Ecuador Eritrea El Salvador Georgia Haiti Kazakhstan Mexico Mongolia Myanmar Nicaragua Panama Paraguay Peru Russia Rwanda Thailand Uruguay Western Sahara Venezuela Vietnam

sources.title: Zambia Department of Immigration, Nationals Who Do Not Require Visa
sources.said: Nationals of the countries listed below do not require visas to enter Zambia.

sources.title: Zambia Department of Immigration, Nationals requiring visas on arrival or from Zambian Missions Abroad

sources.title: Zambia Department of Immigration, Nationals Requiring Visa Prior to Travel
sources.said: Zambian entry visas for nationals whose countries fall under this category require advance clearance by the Zambian Authorities.

sources.title: Zambia Department of Immigration, Zambia Waives Visa Requirements for Nationals of 53 Countries to Boost Tourism (25 December 2024)
sources.said: the visa waiver would take effect on 1 st January 2025. He added that the decision which was in accordance with Statutory Instrument No. 78 of 2024, would see nationals from 53 countries no longer required to obtain a visa to visit Zambia. ... “We are proud to announce that this new visa policy will bring the total number of countries whose nationals are exempt from visa requirements to 167,”
